header: The pads' plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, played with its tools/gamepad_probe.js as the preload
(--preload): four stand-in pads plugged in at the launcher, before Start Game, as a player's pads are there when the
game starts. Their ids are Chrome's on Windows for an Xbox pad over XInput (two), a DualSense and a Bluetooth Xbox
pad, whose ids are longer than SDL keeps and which SDL renames, so the page has to find each by its place in
navigator.getGamepads(). Each pad plays a port of its own in the order they were plugged in
(RECOMPINPUT_PADS_IN_ORDER), the keyboard port 1 beside the first, so at the main menu the game counts four
controllers (gContCount, 0x800C326D). Exhibition then, Novice, Kyoto, and at the players popup the plan makes it 4
players (gGame.numPlayers, 0x800F074C), which the popup offers as there are controllers; at rider select each port
picks with its own pad's A, and the race is a split screen of 4 views. In it each pad in turn holds A, the throttle,
alone, and the plan prints the players' riders' speeds (gRiders, 0x800E4160, 0x7E0 bytes a rider, its speed at
+0x420): that pad's rider alone goes, so each controller plays its own port's rider. Then all of them ride for half a
minute, and the pause menu is opened and closed. padRumbles() says what reached each pad's rumble: the game rumbles a
rider's pad as they land hard or crash.
load: RT64: all [0-9]+ prebuilt shaders built|once the game draws
start: plugPads(["Xbox 360 Controller (XInput STANDARD GAMEPAD)", "Xbox 360 Controller (XInput STANDARD GAMEPAD)", "DualSense Wireless Controller (STANDARD GAMEPAD Vendor: 054c Product: 0ce6)", "Xbox Wireless Controller (STANDARD GAMEPAD Vendor: 045e Product: 0b13)"])

window.padA = (i) => { padSet(i, { buttons: { 0: 1 } }); setTimeout(() => padSet(i), 200); return `pad ${i} A`; }; window.allA = async (test, n) => { for (let k = 0; k < 12 && !test(); k++) { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) padA(i); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); } return test(); }; window.speeds = (n) => { const v = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(4)); const s = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { v.setUint32(0, n64r(0x800E4160 + i * 0x7E0 + 0x420)); s.push(v.getFloat32(0).toFixed(1)); } return s.join(' '); }; 'helpers'
play: padSet(0, { buttons: { 0: 1 } }); padSet(1, { buttons: { 0: 1 } }); padSet(2, { buttons: { 0: 1 } }); padSet(3, { buttons: { 0: 1 } }); 'all A'
